excluded_feature.distance_to_coast_m: all cells are NoData in cell_table.parquet

validation.method: 5-fold GroupKFold by 3 km spatial block; full eligible test blocks evaluated at true prevalence
validation.buffer: Exclude training blocks in the eight-neighbor ring around test blocks; one 3 km block buffer from test-block edge
validation.negative_sampling: stratified without replacement by spatial block
validation.threshold_selection: maximum weighted F1 using in-sample predictions on the sampled training fold; test blocks never used to choose thresholds
validation.threshold_selection_weights: Apply inverse negative-sampling weights when selecting thresholds so the training-fold objective reflects its true prevalence; raw model fitting still uses the specified 3:1 sampled set.
validation.threshold_caveat: Tree models can overfit their in-sample threshold calibration; fold metrics remain out-of-block but threshold choice may be optimistic.

permutation_feature_importance.method: mean decrease in average precision, 2 repeats per fold on up to 2,000 held-out full-prevalence cells
